"""Reviewed consultation instructions, separate from AR geometry recipes."""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from app.schemas.base import ApiModel

RecipeZone = Literal[
    "foundation",
    "brow",
    "eyeshadow",
    "eyeliner",
    "mascara",
    "blush",
    "contour",
    "highlighter",
    "lip",
]


class ConsultationStep(ApiModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)

    order: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=100)
    zone: RecipeZone
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    guide_key: RecipeZone | None = None


class ReviewedProductUsage(ApiModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)
    step_order: int = Field(strict=True, ge=1, le=100)
    product_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128, pattern=r"\S")
    shade_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128, pattern=r"\S")
    evidence_id: str = Field(min_length=1, pattern=r"\S")
    source: str = Field(min_length=1, pattern=r"\S")


class ConsultationRecipe(ApiModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)

    look_id: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$")
    kind: Literal["video"] = "video"
    version: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    review_status: Literal["verified"]
    reviewer_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
    source: str = Field(min_length=1)
    evidence_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
    synthetic: bool = Field(default=False, strict=True)
    features: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    steps: list[ConsultationStep] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    product_usages: list[ReviewedProductUsage] = Field(
        default_factory=list, max_length=100, exclude_if=lambda v: not v
    )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def ordered_steps(self):
        if [step.order for step in self.steps] != list(range(1, len(self.steps) + 1)):
            raise ValueError("Recipe steps must be complete and sequential")
        keys = [(u.step_order, u.product_id, u.shade_id) for u in self.product_usages]
        if any(u.step_order > len(self.steps) for u in self.product_usages) or len(keys) != len(
            set(keys)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid or duplicate product usage step")
        return self

"""Sale identity and recorded price; independent of AR capability."""
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import Field

from app.schemas.base import ApiModel


class ProductOptionImage(ApiModel):
    url: str
    kind: Literal["option", "color_chip", "color_compare"]


class ProductOption(ApiModel):
    product_id: str
    option_id: str
    name: str
    price_krw: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="priceKRW")
    price_basis: Literal["collected_snapshot"] = "collected_snapshot"
    observed_at: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    image: ProductOptionImage | None = None
    ar_shade_id: str | None = None

"""Read one active sale option; no order, ingredient or AR approval side effects."""
from fastapi import Depends
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.db import get_session
from app.core.errors import ApiError
from app.repositories.oy_catalog_repository import OyCatalogRepository
from app.schemas.product_option import ProductOption, ProductOptionImage


class ProductOptionService:
    def __init__(self, repository: OyCatalogRepository):
        self.repository = repository

    async def get_option(self, product_id: str, option_id: str) -> ProductOption:
        identity = await self.repository.option_identity(option_id, product_id)
        if identity is None:
            raise ApiError(404, "Sale option not found", "option_not_found")
        price = await self.repository.option_price(option_id, product_id)
        image = await self.repository.option_image(option_id, product_id)
        return ProductOption(
            product_id=product_id, option_id=identity[0], name=identity[1] or identity[0],
            price_krw=price[1] if price and price[1] is not None and price[1] >= 0 else None,
            observed_at=price[2].isoformat() if price and price[2] else None,
            source_url=identity[3],
            image=ProductOptionImage(url=image[0], kind=image[1]) if image else None,
            ar_shade_id=await self.repository.option_ar_shade(option_id, product_id),
        )


def get_product_option_service(
    session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),
) -> ProductOptionService:
    return ProductOptionService(OyCatalogRepository(session))

"""Mock repository/HTTP contracts. Live Catalog evidence is recorded separately."""
from datetime import datetime
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.core.errors import ApiError
from app.main import create_app
from app.services.product_option_service import ProductOptionService, get_product_option_service


@pytest.fixture
def anyio_backend():
    return "asyncio"


@pytest.fixture
def repository():
    return SimpleNamespace(
        option_identity=AsyncMock(return_value=("o2", "Option 2", None, "https://example.test/p")),
        option_price=AsyncMock(return_value=(1, 1200, datetime(2026, 10, 28), "https://example.test/p")),
        option_image=AsyncMock(return_value=("https://example.test/chip.jpg", "color_chip")),
        option_ar_shade=AsyncMock(return_value=None),
    )


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_exact_option_and_recorded_price(repository):
    result = await ProductOptionService(repository).get_option("p", "o2")
    assert result.option_id == "o2"
    assert result.price_krw == 1200
    assert result.image.kind == "color_chip"
    assert result.ar_shade_id is None
    assert result.observed_at == "2026-10-28T00:00:00"
    assert result.model_dump()["priceKRW"] == 1200
    repository.option_price.assert_awaited_once_with("o2", "p")


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_unknowns_are_preserved(repository):
    repository.option_price.return_value = None
    repository.option_image.return_value = None
    result = await ProductOptionService(repository).get_option("p", "o2")
    assert result.price_krw is None and result.image is None
    assert result.ar_shade_id is None


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_wrong_or_delisted_identity_stops_lookup(repository):
    repository.option_identity.return_value = None
    with pytest.raises(ApiError):
        await ProductOptionService(repository).get_option("wrong-product", "o2")
    repository.option_price.assert_not_awaited()
    repository.option_ar_shade.assert_not_awaited()


def test_http_contract_no_store(repository):
    app = create_app()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_product_option_service] = lambda: ProductOptionService(repository)
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        result = client.get("/api/products/p/options/o2")
    assert result.status_code == 200
    assert result.headers["cache-control"] == "no-store"
    assert result.json()["priceKRW"] == 1200
    assert result.json()["optionId"] == "o2"

"""Server-owned coordination metadata, never an execution capability or product evidence."""

from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator
from pydantic.alias_generators import to_camel

from app.schemas.style_recipe import StyleContext, Zone

GoalKind = Literal["skin", "owned_look", "knowledge", "style"]
GoalStatus = Literal["pending", "completed", "partial", "waiting_user", "failed", "superseded"]


class ParentModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")


class ParentTask(ParentModel):
    goal: GoalKind
    objective: str = ""
    status: GoalStatus = "pending"
    version: int = Field(ge=1)
    depends_on: list[GoalKind] = Field(default_factory=list)
    input_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reference_digest: str | None = None
    result_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    limitations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ParentQuestion(ParentModel):
    goal: GoalKind
    version: int = Field(ge=1)
    text: str
    input_key: Literal["ownership", "situation", "selection", "consent"]
    zone: Zone | None = None


class ConsultationParent(ParentModel):
    schema_version: Literal[1] = 1
    plan_id: UUID = Field(default_factory=uuid4)
    version: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    # Closed capabilities: at most one task of each kind per conversational revision.
    tasks: list[ParentTask] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=4)
    question: ParentQuestion | None = None
    look: StyleContext | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def coherent(self):
        if len({t.goal for t in self.tasks}) != len(self.tasks):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate parent goal")
        if any(t.version > self.version for t in self.tasks):
            raise ValueError("Future task revision")
        if self.question and self.question.version != self.version:
            raise ValueError("Stale question revision")
        return self

"""Real parent LangGraph, synthetic specialists/Catalog. No external model calls."""

import json
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import UpstreamError
from app.schemas.chat import ChatRequest, ChatResponse
from app.schemas.consultation_parent import ConsultationParent, ParentTask
from app.schemas.knowledge import KnowledgeReply
from app.services import consultation_parent_graph as parent
from app.services.chat_service import ChatService
from app.services.conversation_context import prepare_request, updated_context
from app.services.knowledge_service import Consultation
from tests.conftest import FakeLlm
from tests.test_g8_owned_look import Catalog, owned, request


@pytest.fixture
def anyio_backend():
    return "asyncio"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def enabled(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g8_enabled", True)


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_result_binding_changes_actual_knowledge_input(monkeypatch, record_property):
    calls = []

    async def knowledge(question, *, prior_user_context):
        calls.append(json.loads(prior_user_context))
        return Consultation(
            KnowledgeReply(status="insufficient_evidence", limitations="합성 근거 부족"), {}
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(parent.knowledge_service, "consult_knowledge", knowledge)
    catalog = Catalog()
    req = request([owned("lip-a", "lip-a-shade")], "블러셔는 없어. 이 룩 순서의 이유도 설명해줘.")
    service = ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), catalog)
    first = await service.answer(req)
    assert [p.id for p in first.products] == ["blush-b"]
    assert [t.goal for t in first._consultation_parent.tasks] == ["owned_look", "knowledge"]
    assert first._consultation_parent.tasks[-1].input_refs
    catalog.look.recipe.steps[0].description = "변경된 합성 볼 단계"
    second = await service.answer(req)
    assert (
        calls[0]["styleRecipe"]["steps"][0]["description"]
        != calls[1]["styleRecipe"]["steps"][0]["description"]
    )
    assert second.knowledge.status == "insufficient_evidence"
    assert second._consultation_parent.tasks[-1].status == "partial"
    assert second.ar_result is None and second.memory_proposal is None
    record_property(
        "parent_evidence",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "catalogMode": "mock",
                "modelConfiguredMode": "mock",
                "externalModelCalls": 0,
                "turns": [
                    {
                        "modelMode": "mock",
                        "externalModelCalls": 0,
                        "tasks": r._parent_trace,
                        "response": r.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True),
                    }
                    for r in (first, second)
                ],
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
    )


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_knowledge_failure_keeps_product_result(monkeypatch):
    async def failure(*args, **kwargs):
        raise UpstreamError("synthetic unavailable")

    monkeypatch.setattr(parent.knowledge_service, "consult_knowledge", failure)
    response = await ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), Catalog()).answer(
        request([owned("lip-a", "lip-a-shade")], "블러셔는 없어. 주의점도 설명해줘.")
    )
    assert [p.id for p in response.products] == ["blush-b"]
    assert response._consultation_parent.tasks[-1].status == "failed"
    assert "유지" in response.answer


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_persisted_question_bare_answer_and_targeted_product_opt_out():
    catalog = Catalog()
    service = ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), catalog)
    req = request([owned("lip-a", "lip-a-shade")])
    first = await service.answer(req)
    assert first._consultation_parent.question.zone == "blush"
    raw = updated_context({}, first)
    # Serialize/validate just as the server does; no client-supplied parent fields.
    next_req = prepare_request(req.model_copy(update={"message": "없어"}), raw, [])
    assert "블러셔" in next_req.message
    second = await service.answer(next_req)
    assert [p.id for p in second.products] == ["blush-b"]
    assert second._consultation_parent.plan_id == first._consultation_parent.plan_id
    assert second._consultation_parent.version == 2
    assert second._consultation_parent.question is None
    third_req = prepare_request(
        req.model_copy(update={"message": "상품은 됐고 사용 순서만 알려줘"}),
        updated_context(raw, second),
        [],
    )
    before = len(catalog.searches)
    third = await service.answer(third_req)
    assert not third.products
    assert len(catalog.searches) == before
    assert (
        next(t for t in third._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "owned_look").status
        == "superseded"
    )
    assert third.style_recipe and third._owned_look_context == second._owned_look_context
    assert "consultationParent" not in third.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_ambiguous_answer_and_changed_look_do_not_reuse_question():
    req = request([owned("lip-a", "lip-a-shade")])
    first = await ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), Catalog()).answer(req)
    ambiguous = parent.restore_followup(
        req.model_copy(update={"message": "응"}), first._consultation_parent
    )
    assert ambiguous.message == "응"
    changed = ChatRequest(message="없어", styleContext={"kind": "catalog", "lookId": "another"})
    assert parent.restore_followup(changed, first._consultation_parent)._consultation_parent is None


def test_stale_task_result_rejected():
    state = ConsultationParent(version=2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Stale"):
        parent.accept_task(state, ParentTask(goal="knowledge", version=1), state.plan_id)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Stale"):
        parent.accept_task(state, ParentTask(goal="knowledge", version=2), uuid4())


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_n01_uses_same_parent_without_changing_payload():
    response = ChatResponse(
        answer="어떤 상황에 화장이 뜨나요?", products=[], resultType="clarification"
    )

    async def skin():
        return response

    result = await parent.run_parent(ChatRequest(message="화장이 떠요"), "skin", skin)
    assert result is response
    assert result._consultation_parent.question.input_key == "situation"
    assert result._consultation_parent.tasks[0].status == "waiting_user"


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_normal_n01_entry_reaches_parent(monkeypatch):
    from app.services import compound_consultation_graph as skin

    async def interpret(*args):
        return skin.Interpretation(
            scope="consultation", action="clarify", question="어떤 상황에 뜨나요?"
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(skin, "interpret", interpret)
    req = ChatRequest(
        message="오후에 화장이 뜨는데 원인 알려주고 나한테 맞는 제품도 찾아줘", locale="ko"
    )
    result = await ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), Catalog()).answer(req)
    assert result._consultation_parent.question.input_key == "situation"
    assert result._consultation_parent.tasks[0].goal == "skin"


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_price_only_change_retains_explanation_reference(monkeypatch):
    from tests.test_g8_owned_look import FilteredCatalog

    calls = []

    async def knowledge(question, **kwargs):
        calls.append(question)
        return Consultation(KnowledgeReply(status="insufficient_evidence"), {})

    monkeypatch.setattr(parent.knowledge_service, "consult_knowledge", knowledge)
    catalog = FilteredCatalog()
    service = ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), catalog)
    req = request([owned("lip-a", "lip-a-shade")], "블러셔는 없어. 순서를 설명해줘.")
    first = await service.answer(req)
    old = next(t for t in first._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "knowledge")
    raw = updated_context({}, first)
    followup = prepare_request(req.model_copy(update={"message": "예산은 2만원 이하"}), raw, [])
    second = await service.answer(followup)
    kept = next(t for t in second._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "knowledge")
    assert kept == old and len(calls) == 1
    assert catalog.option_calls[-1].max_price_krw == 20000
    catalog.look.recipe.steps[0].description = "다른 단계"
    changed = prepare_request(
        req.model_copy(update={"message": "예산은 1만원 이하"}), updated_context(raw, second), []
    )
    third = await service.answer(changed)
    assert (
        next(t for t in third._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "knowledge").status
        == "superseded"
    )

"""API-produced test response replayed through the real CatalogClient and N02.

Catalog data/review/transport are synthetic. No live model or PostgreSQL claim.
"""

import json
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import httpx
import pytest

from app.clients.catalog_client import CatalogClient
from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.services.chat_service import ChatService
from tests.conftest import FakeLlm
from tests.test_g8_owned_look import product, request


@pytest.fixture
def anyio_backend():
    return "asyncio"


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_api_recipe_reaches_n02_exact_product_and_parent(monkeypatch, record_property):
    path = os.environ.get("G8_RECIPE_API_JUNIT")
    if not path:
        pytest.skip("API recipe_delivery_payload JUnit required")
    properties = ET.parse(path).findall(".//property[@name='recipe_delivery_payload']")
    assert len(properties) == 1
    payload = json.loads(properties[0].attrib["value"])
    calls = []

    def handle(req):
        calls.append(str(req.url))
        if req.url.path == "/api/style-looks":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=payload)
        row = product("blush-b", "blush").model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True)
        if req.url.path == "/api/products/blush-b":
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"product": row})
        if req.url.path == "/api/products":
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"products": [row]})
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected Catalog request: {req.url.path}")

    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g8_enabled", True)
    req = request([], "블러셔는 없어.")
    req.style_context.kind = "video"
    original_client = httpx.AsyncClient
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        httpx,
        "AsyncClient",
        lambda **kwargs: original_client(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle), **kwargs),
    )
    catalog = CatalogClient("http://catalog.test")
    response = await ChatService(None, FakeLlm(configured=False), catalog).answer(req)
    assert response.style_recipe.basis == "reviewed_recipe"
    assert response.style_recipe.evidence_id == "fixture:evidence"
    usage = response.style_recipe.products[0].product_usages[0]
    assert usage.evidence_id == "fixture:usage" and usage.step_order == 1
    assert usage.shade_id == "blush-b-shade"
    assert [p.id for p in response.products] == ["blush-b"]
    assert response._consultation_parent.tasks[0].goal == "owned_look"
    record_property(
        "recipe_delivery_evidence",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "dataMode": "mock",
                "transportMode": "mock",
                "modelMode": "not_used",
                "externalModelCalls": 0,
                "requests": calls,
                "response": response.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True),
                "tasks": response._parent_trace,
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
    )
